parsed.name: 短波红外高光谱相机帧采集单元
parsed.description: 用于接收并采集短波红外高光谱相机图像数据的帧采集单元，通常与 Specim SWIR 成像系统配合使用。在实验室中可用于连续获取样品的短波红外高光谱数据流，服务于成像、检测与分析实验。
parsed.description_en: A frame grabber unit used to receive and acquire image data from a short-wave infrared hyperspectral camera, typically as part of a Specim SWIR imaging system. In laboratory use, it supports continuous collection of SWIR hyperspectral data streams for imaging, inspection, and analysis experiments.

actions.description: 获取帧采集是否正在运行。
actions.description_en: Get whether frame acquisition is running.
